name: Achensee Strandbad
kurzbeschreibung: The lidos of Lake Achensee in Pertisau, Maurach, and Buchau feature manicured sunbathing lawns, shallow swimming bays, diving piers, and alpine watersports.
preis: Access varies by lido (Buchau/Pertisau free or modest entry; pay-and-display parking applies)
oeffnungszeiten: Lido swimming facilities open May to September; shoreline walkways accessible year-round
beschreibung:
Überblick

The scenic lidos of Lake Achensee (Achensee Strandbäder) grace the sunny shoreline of Tirol's premier alpine lake, offering refreshing mountain swimming against the limestone backdrop of the Karwendel and Rofan ranges. Resting at 929 metres elevation, Lake Achensee's drinking-water-pure glacial waters warm to invigorating temperatures between nineteen and twenty-two degrees Celsius during midsummer. The foremost recreational swimming centers are located at Strandbad Buchau near Maurach, the contemporary Atoll Achensee leisure campus, and the historical lido in Pertisau on the western bank. Strandbad Buchau is renowned for its expansive, shallow sand-and-gravel shelves extending dozens of metres into the lake, where sheltered waters warm more rapidly, creating safe paddling conditions for young children. Manicured sunbathing lawns and timber piers invite swimmers to bask in alpine sunshine.

Route & Anforderungen

The lakeside lido complexes are modern, fully barrier-free, and furnished with exceptional family amenities. Strandbad Buchau at the southeastern lake corner features broad wading zones, water playgrounds, beach volleyball courts, and direct access for paddleboarders and pedal boat rentals. In Pertisau, the historic lido boasts deep-water swimming docks, diving platforms, and sunbathing decks extending above clear turquoise depths. A short stroll away, the Atoll Achensee complex provides heated lakeside pools and dedicated lakeshore access. Standard swimwear, sun protection, and water shoes for pebble beaches are recommended. All lidos offer accessible changing rooms, showers, and waterfront bistros.

Besuch & Anreise

Access by road proceeds via motorway A12 (exit Wiesing/Achensee) along the B181 highway to Maurach, Buchau, or Pertisau. Frequent VVT regional buses connect from Jenbach railway station every thirty minutes. Ample pay-and-display parking lots are situated directly adjacent to all lidos. Holders of the regional AchenseeCard travel free on local bus lines throughout the valley.

Tipps

Head to Strandbad Buchau during the morning hours to enjoy tranquil, wind-sheltered waters before afternoon thermal breezes arrive. Stand-up paddleboard rentals are available on-site, enabling serene paddles along the pristine cliffs of the Rofan shore.
